title: Drivers Dissatisfaction
statementMd:
In one kingdom there are $*n*$ cities and $*m*$ two-way roads. Each road connects a pair of cities, and for each road we know the level of drivers dissatisfaction — the value $*w*_{*i*}$.

For each road we know the value $*c*_{*i*}$ — how many lamziks we should spend to reduce the level of dissatisfaction with this road by one. Thus, to reduce the dissatisfaction with the $*i*$-th road by $*k*$, we should spend $*k*·*c*_{*i*}$ lamziks. And **it is allowed for the dissatisfaction to become zero or even negative**.

In accordance with the king's order, we need to choose $*n* - 1$ roads and make them the *main roads*. An important condition must hold: it should be possible to travel from any city to any other by the *main roads*.

The road ministry has a budget of $*S*$ lamziks for the reform. The ministry is going to spend this budget for repair of some roads (to reduce the dissatisfaction with them), and then to choose the $*n* - 1$ *main roads*.

Help to spend the budget in such a way and then to choose the main roads so that the total dissatisfaction with the *main roads* will be as small as possible. The dissatisfaction with some roads can become negative. It is not necessary to spend whole budget $*S*$.

It is guaranteed that it is possible to travel from any city to any other using existing roads. Each road in the kingdom is a two-way road.

## Input

The first line contains two integers $*n*$ and $*m*$ ($2 ≤ *n* ≤ 2·10^{5}$, $*n* - 1 ≤ *m* ≤ 2·10^{5}$) — the number of cities and the number of roads in the kingdom, respectively.

The second line contains $*m*$ integers $*w*_{1}, *w*_{2}, ..., *w*_{*m*}$ ($1 ≤ *w*_{*i*} ≤ 10^{9}$), where $*w*_{*i*}$ is the drivers dissatisfaction with the $*i*$-th road.

The third line contains $*m*$ integers $*c*_{1}, *c*_{2}, ..., *c*_{*m*}$ ($1 ≤ *c*_{*i*} ≤ 10^{9}$), where $*c*_{*i*}$ is the cost (in lamziks) of reducing the dissatisfaction with the $*i*$-th road by one.

The next $*m*$ lines contain the description of the roads. The $*i*$-th of this lines contain a pair of integers $*a*_{*i*}$ and $*b*_{*i*}$ ($1 ≤ *a*_{*i*}, *b*_{*i*} ≤ *n*$, $*a*_{*i*} ≠ *b*_{*i*}$) which mean that the $*i*$-th road connects cities $*a*_{*i*}$ and $*b*_{*i*}$. All roads are two-way oriented so it is possible to move by the $*i*$-th road from $*a*_{*i*}$ to $*b*_{*i*}$, and vice versa. It is allowed that a pair of cities is connected by more than one road.

The last line contains one integer $*S*$ ($0 ≤ *S* ≤ 10^{9}$) — the number of lamziks which we can spend for reforms.

## Output

In the first line print $*K*$ — the minimum possible total dissatisfaction with *main roads*.

In each of the next $*n* - 1$ lines print two integers $*x*, *v*_{*x*}$, which mean that the road $*x*$ is among main roads and the road $*x*$, after the reform, has the level of dissatisfaction $*v*_{*x*}$.

Consider that roads are numbered from $1$ to $*m*$ in the order as they are given in the input data. The edges can be printed in arbitrary order. If there are several answers, print any of them.
statementZhMd:
在一个王国中有 $*n*$ 座城市和 $*m*$ 条双向道路。每条道路连接一对城市，并且我们知道每条道路上司机的不满程度——其值为 $*w*_{*i*}$。

对于每条道路，我们还知道 $*c*_{*i*}$——将该道路的不满程度降低 1 所需花费的 lamziks 数量。因此，要将第 $*i*$ 条道路的不满程度降低 $*k*$，需要花费 $*k*·*c*_{*i*}$ 个 lamziks。并且，**允许将不满程度降低至零甚至负数**。

根据国王的命令，我们需要选择 $*n* - 1$ 条道路，将它们设为*主干道*。必须满足一个重要条件：仅通过*主干道*，应当能够从任意城市到达任意其他城市。

道路部门为此次改革准备了 $*S*$ 个 lamziks 的预算。道路部门计划用这笔预算维修部分道路（降低它们的不满程度），然后选择 $*n* - 1$ 条*主干道*。

请帮助道路部门合理使用预算，并选择主干道，使主干道的不满程度总和尽可能小。不满程度可以变为负数。不必花完全部预算 $*S*$。

保证使用现有道路可以从任意城市到达任意其他城市。王国中的每条道路都是双向道路。

## 输入格式

第一行包含两个整数 $*n*$ 和 $*m*$（$2 ≤ *n* ≤ 2·10^{5}$，$*n* - 1 ≤ *m* ≤ 2·10^{5}$）——王国中的城市数和道路数。

第二行包含 $*m*$ 个整数 $*w*_{1}, *w*_{2}, ..., *w*_{*m*}$（$1 ≤ *w*_{*i*} ≤ 10^{9}$），其中 $*w*_{*i*}$ 表示第 $*i*$ 条道路上司机的不满程度。

第三行包含 $*m*$ 个整数 $*c*_{1}, *c*_{2}, ..., *c*_{*m*}$（$1 ≤ *c*_{*i*} ≤ 10^{9}$），其中 $*c*_{*i*}$ 表示将第 $*i*$ 条道路的不满程度降低 1 所需的费用（以 lamziks 计）。

接下来的 $*m*$ 行描述道路。第 $*i*$ 行包含两个整数 $*a*_{*i*}$ 和 $*b*_{*i*}$（$1 ≤ *a*_{*i*}, *b*_{*i*} ≤ *n*$，$*a*_{*i*} ≠ *b*_{*i*}$），表示第 $*i*$ 条道路连接城市 $*a*_{*i*}$ 和 $*b*_{*i*}$。所有道路都是双向的，因此可以通过第 $*i*$ 条道路从 $*a*_{*i*}$ 前往 $*b*_{*i*}$，反之亦然。允许一对城市之间存在多条道路。

最后一行包含一个整数 $*S*$（$0 ≤ *S* ≤ 10^{9}$）——我们可以用于改革的 lamziks 数量。

## 输出格式

第一行输出 $*K*$——主干道不满程度总和的最小可能值。

接下来的 $*n* - 1$ 行中，每行输出两个整数 $*x*, *v*_{*x*}$，表示第 $*x*$ 条道路是主干道，并且改革后第 $*x*$ 条道路的不满程度为 $*v*_{*x*}$。

道路编号按照它们在输入数据中的出现顺序，从 1 到 $*m*$ 编号。可以按任意顺序输出这些道路。如果有多个答案，输出任意一个即可。
